## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) (`feat(core): …`, `fix(vue): …`):
      it becomes the commit message and a changelog entry.
- [ ] Tests cover the new rules or behaviour.
- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass locally.
- [ ] Interface and CLI texts exist in French and English (`pnpm i18n:check`).
- [ ] New screens and components meet WCAG 2.2 AA.
- [ ] Database changes come with a migration for each provider.
- [ ] New environment variables are documented and classified for `surge-media diagnose`.
- [ ] Documentation updated (`setup.md`, website) if users see the change.
